$comment: Cases known to fail against the in-repo bed for reasons that are NOT compiler defects. Each entry must name why, so the list stays auditable and shrinks when a cause is fixed. The eval subtracts these to report regressions instead of a permanently red count; a listed case that PASSES is reported too — the reason has gone stale.
